0022600102.text: The Lakers, 1-0 and 1-0 at home, host the LA Clippers, who are also 1-0 and sit first in the Pacific while the Lakers are second there and fourth in the West. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Lakers winning the last meeting 125-122 in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026. Lakers Adou Thiero (knee) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain) are out, and Jake LaRavia is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery).
